conf.description: Ivanti ICS events log, WELF (syslog-kv) alternate: same full envelope shape as user/admin access, but SYS/ERR classes render almost nothing into it - included per the work order as a genuine per-log-type option, not the recommended default (Standard is preferred for this log).

conf.comment: Ivanti ICS events, WELF filter. Recorded here because ICS lets format be chosen per log type, but per the catalog this is rarely worth taking for Events: SYS/ERR render almost nothing into the envelope, so the id-driven msg parse does the real work either way. The one thing WELF adds over Standard for this log is a body pri= severity key (Standard leaves severity to the syslog header only).

functions.description: why this alternate exists and what it actually buys

conf.regex: /^id=\S+ time="(?<time>[^"]*)" pri=(?<pri>\d*) fw=(?<fw>\S*) vpn=(?<vpn>\S*) ivs=(?<ivs>.*?) user=(?<user>\S*) realm="(?<realm>[^"]*)" roles="[^"]*" proto=\S* src=\S* dst=\S* dstname=\S* type=(?<type>\S*) op=\S* arg="[^"]*" result=\S* sent=\S* rcvd=\S* agent="[^"]*" duration=\S* msg="(?<msg>.*)"$/

functions.description: split the full WELF envelope (mostly empty for SYS/ERR classes)

event.code from the msgid; ivs/realm/type to customs; integrity-id passthrough (no invented pass/fail semantics); pri (this variant's one advantage over Standard) to log.syslog.severity.code; _time; event.dataset
